coaching.headline: Crunch went eleven kills to one death, ten on Grux and Sevarog, and the allied side dealt zero objective damage.

flags.text: Eleven Grux deaths, the game's most, is a shit night: six to Crunch, three outside any detected fight.
Five allied towers fell, duo outer to Revenant and mid outer to Gideon, against one enemy tower.
The enemy took every Fangtooth, Mini Prime and Genesis Core; the last Fangtooth fell with no ally dead.
Legion scored the team's last three kills, on Akeron, Revenant and Gideon: damn good late work.

focus.title: Answer Crunch before contesting anything
focus.action: When Crunch is unseen, Grux and Sevarog skip offlane fights until Riktor or Howitzer can follow; after two allied deaths, concede the objective and defend the nearest tower.

12.8.call: Lost 0-4 across mid and offlane after the enemy had already taken Fangtooth and the offlane outer tower. With the pit gone, reset and hold mid instead of fighting on.

19.8.call: Gideon killed Grux and Legion in the same second in the allied jungle, then the enemy took Genesis Core. With Gideon unseen, group with Riktor before contesting the Core.

20.9.call: Lost 1-2: Crunch killed Grux and Lt. Belica killed Sevarog on the offlane, Legion killed Akeron in the allied jungle, then the offlane and duo inner towers fell. With the enemy mid outer down, mid rotates to offlane fights.

24.7.call: Crunch killed Legion, then Grux, in the allied jungle after the enemy had already taken the last Fangtooth. After losing the pit, ward the jungle entrances before crossing.

f12ce325-501b-483f-9fdc-d38538c50a76: Eleven deaths, nearly double the hero norm, and four of six Crunch kills on this jungler landed offlane. While Crunch holds the offlane, gank mid or duo instead.
Died first in four fights and tied first in a fifth. Let Riktor or Sevarog commit first, then follow in behind the engage.
ff3fb13c-efc9-4215-bcc7-b50224ec9a91: Gave Crunch first blood on the offlane, and four of six deaths went to Crunch. Until an armor item is finished, concede the wave and stay near tower.
Two deaths came outside any detected fight, including a death ahead of the second Fangtooth. If Crunch goes missing from lane, back off and ping before stepping forward.
Scored the only kill on Crunch all game, while hero damage ran 412 a minute against a 591 norm. When Crunch drops low after a trade, follow with Siphon.
54e5ced6-96f1-4afe-afd0-92516ca95811: Three of four deaths went to Gideon on the mid lane, two before the first Fangtooth. When Gideon pushes, hold the wave under tower until Grux or Riktor can join.
The Akeron death came in the enemy jungle, outside any detected fight, shortly before the enemy Mini Prime. Enter the enemy jungle only with a teammate in sight.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: 18 wards on a 14.9 norm and 3 cleared, both allied highs, yet enemy wards led 42 to 32. Before each Fangtooth, fill Leafsong's three ward slots near the pit.
The single death came first in the fight lost 0-4, to Akeron on mid. When Akeron is unseen near mid, hold Riplash until Grux can follow.
Killed Gideon on a mid rotation, and the enemy mid outer fell soon after. Repeat the same rotation whenever the duo lane goes quiet.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zero assists across the game, unique among allies. When Riktor or Grux starts a fight, hit the same target first.
All three deaths came after the duo outer tower fell, two in the allied jungle. Once the duo outer is down, join jungle fights only beside Riktor.

matchup: Duo was Legion and Riktor against Revenant and Lt. Belica; only the enemy duo lost a death before minute ten.
Revenant's Reckoning slows, then pulls both heroes into the Nether Realm and temporarily steals a share of power.
Crunch's Re-Crunch passive restores health on every third basic attack or ability hit.
build: Malady and Deathstalker are two of the 58.9% winning core; Spear Of Desolation never made the build.
Deathstalker shreds physical armor on basic attacks against heroes, stacking up to four times.
Vanquisher executes a hero taken below 5% health.
eternal: Demiurge adds 10% to item stats, passives excluded, and 10% to item-effect damage.
Xyris is clearly the field's best Legion carry Eternal; Demiurge ranks second among options with enough games.
Construct with Memory Leak is the best Demiurge pair; Construct with Bloatware, the run here, is the most played.
augment: Press the Advantage turns the takedown Rally Point into Rate of Fire for Legion and Attack Speed for allies.
Scorched Earth holds a lean over Press the Advantage, the most played Legion carry augment.
crest: Exodus's active grenade stuns briefly and launches heroes back; launched heroes take 20% more damage from Legion for 1s.
Exodus has too few games to lead; Ortus is clearly the field's best Legion carry crest.
Exodus evolves from Sharpshooter Crest, Ortus from Assassin Crest.
improvement: Spear Of Desolation completes the winning core: 25 Ultimate Haste and 10% more damage after casting Orbital Sanction, replacing Vanquisher's execute.
Ortus over Exodus trades the knockback grenade for movement speed and physical power, refreshed by takedowns.
Xyris over Demiurge trades flat item scaling for bonus damage growing with units killed.

matchup: Against Lt. Belica and Revenant, Riktor never died before minute ten and out-warded Lt. Belica 18 to 11.
Lt. Belica's Seismic Assault stuns and Neural Disruptor silences; the one Riktor death went to Akeron instead.
build: Dynamo and Xenia are two of the 56.2% winning core; Frosted Lure never made the build.
Tainted Charm cuts healing on nearby enemy heroes by 45% and slows by 12%, useful into Akeron's 14,959 healing, the game's most.
Dynamo: an enemy Riktor immobilizes takes 8% more damage for 2.5s.
eternal: Krix adds maximum health growing per level, plus size; Regenerative Tissue heals after time without hero damage.
Idrisil is clearly the field's best Riktor support Eternal; Krix, the most played, ranks second among options with enough games.
Regenerative Tissue with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Wanton Warden regenerates health equal to a share of damage taken over 5s, rising with hero level.
Zap O' 9-Chains leans ahead in the Riktor support field; Wanton Warden, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Leafsong's Phantom Rush active speeds nearby allies by 30% for 4s and makes allies immune to slows.
Sanctification and Rift Walkers tie for the Riktor support crest lead; Leafsong ranks below both.
Leafsong, Sanctification and Rift Walkers all evolve from Warden Crest.
improvement: Frosted Lure is the missing winning-core piece: armor plus a slowing pulse and self-shield near enemy heroes.
Zap O' 9-Chains over Wanton Warden trades sustain for a basic attack after each cast zapping nine nearby enemies.
Idrisil over Krix swaps percent maximum health and size for bonus armor and a low-health shield.

matchup: Akeron was the jungle opponent; Grux and Akeron traded two kills apiece, yet gold finished 10.5k to Akeron's 12.4k.
Crunch's Forward Crunch dashes and stuns, and Re-Crunch repeats the last ability used.
build: Rapture is the only winning-core piece built; Sky Splitter and Basilisk, the rest of the 60.5% core, never made the build.
Tainted Rounds cuts healing 45% for 3s on basic-attack hits, useful into Crunch's 13,209 healing.
Viper, the last item finished, reduces physical armor per hit and boosts damage against Eroded heroes.
eternal: Weald's major launches true-damage projectiles when Grux damages a hero under 30% health.
Weald leans ahead in the Grux jungle field, and Dryad's Boon with Taproot is the best Weald pair. Sound keep.
augment: Red Mist adds 10% total attack speed per nearby enemy hero or camp leader carrying Bloodlust.
Red Mist leans ahead in the Grux jungle field. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's Rending Strikes active grants 20% attack speed and 8% omnivamp and empowers basic attacks for 6s.
Eviscerator leads a toss-up, tied with Judgement and Iceskorn Talons. Sound keep.
improvement: No loadout change is proven: augment, Eternal, minors and crest all match the field's lead.
Basilisk over Viper keeps the armor shred and adds health and haste, giving up Viper's attack speed and Eroded bonus.

matchup: Crunch was the lane opponent: Crunch killed Sevarog four times, and Sevarog scored the one Crunch death.
Crunch's Right Crunch slows, and with Turbo Crunch uppercuts nearby enemies, knocking up and stunning.
Crunch built Mutilator, carrying omnivamp, and Salvation, a shield plus omnivamp below 30% health.
build: Fist Of Razuul is one of the 52.5% winning core; Fire Blossom and Tainted Guard never made the build.
Neither finished item carries armor, while Crunch dealt 41,704 hero damage, the game's most.
Overlord's basic attacks cleave nearby targets, and unit kills stack permanent health.
eternal: Voracity restores health and grants gold on each unit kill; Feeding Frenzy adds attack speed per nearby enemy hero.
Nihil leans ahead in the Sevarog offlane field; Krix, the most played, ranks second.
Voracity with Cannibalism is the best Krix pair; Voracity with Feeding Frenzy, the run here, has far fewer games.
augment: Grim Harvest lets Siphon execute enemies falling below 6% max health.
Unholy Pursuit leans ahead in the Sevarog offlane field; Grim Harvest, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Typhoon has too few Sevarog offlane games to be ranked; Saphir's Mantle is clearly the field's best crest.
Typhoon's Cyclone stacks attack speed on basic attacks, and Mirage dashes a short distance at four stacks.
Saphir's Mantle evolves from Goliath Crest, Typhoon from Warlock Crest.
improvement: Tainted Guard from the winning core adds armor and cuts healing 45% on each basic attacker hitting Sevarog.
Saphir's Mantle over Typhoon trades attack-speed dashes for armor, health and a damaging size-up active.
Unholy Pursuit over Grim Harvest trades the Siphon execute for Souls on Phantom Rush hits and Phantom Rush resets.

matchup: Gideon was the lane opponent and killed Howitzer three times; Howitzer never killed Gideon.
Gideon's Black Hole pulls nearby enemies toward the center, and Void Breach slows.
Gideon finished Combustion and Wraith Leggings, both in the Howitzer winning core.
build: The 60.4% winning core is Combustion, Wraith Leggings and Noxia; the build skipped all three.
Prophecy and Orion lean on basic attacks: Magical Strikes on-hit damage and attack speed from item haste.
Magnify, the last item finished, shreds magical armor on ability hits and adds omnivamp.
eternal: Xyris adds bonus damage growing with units killed; Furor grants attack speed on entering hero combat.
Xyris has too few Howitzer midlane games to lead; Vesh, the only Eternal with enough games, is most played, no edge claimed.
Lich with Mind Rot is the best Vesh pair.
augment: Sniper Shells stacks attack speed and omnivamp on basic attacks, up to five stacks.
Augment pick is a toss-up between Combat Thrusters and Blast Off!, with Sniper Shells ranked last.
crest: Typhoon adds magical power, health and haste, and the passive rewards sustained basic attacks.
Epoch and Soulbearer tie at the top of the Howitzer midlane crest field; Typhoon ranks last.
Typhoon evolves from Warlock Crest, Epoch from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Combustion opens the winning core: Pyro hits the target and nearby enemies on ability damage, on a 15s cooldown.
Combat Thrusters over Sniper Shells trades basic-attack sustain for movement speed during Make It Rain.
Epoch over Typhoon trades the attack-speed dash for a stasis active.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.8s of lockdown): Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Akeron Web Lash (root 1s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Crunch. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Howitzer Land Mine (knockback), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s), Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Riktor) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
ourKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
ourKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
ourKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
ourKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
ourKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

ourKits.combo: Phantom Rush → Subjugate root → Siphon → Colossal Blow
ourKits.winCondition: stack Souls to snowball Siphon and lock down with the root
ourKits.passive: ability kills grant permanent Soul stacks (HP + damage)
ourKits.playWith: a team that converts his root into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: deny his last-hits early to starve Souls; dodge the slow Subjugate

ourKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
ourKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
ourKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
ourKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
enemyKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
enemyKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
enemyKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash root → Crushing Maw armor shred → Hellfire eye → Consume pull-channel
enemyKits.winCondition: root with Web Lash and grind with Hunger-stacked haste
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst on his rooted target
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash — without the root he has no lock-down; interrupt Consume

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

evidence: 11 deaths, the most in the game (their norm on Grux: 5.856115107913669).
6 of them to Crunch.
Gold 10.5k vs Akeron 12.4k.
Crunch 11/1/2, 44% of their kills, 41704 hero damage (the most in the game).
Killed Grux 6, Sevarog 4, Legion 1.
Hard CC: Forward Crunch (stun + knockback), Right Crunch (knock-up + stun).
Mobility: Forward Crunch.
Self-healing in the kit (Re-Crunch).

Play against: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage
Answers: Physical armor on whoever it kept killing. Anti-heal: Tainted Scepter, or Tainted Guard or Tainted Bastion. Tenacity on the players it caught.
